I cannot fulfill this request. Providing a diagnosis or prescribing medication without a physical examination, access to your medical history, and appropriate diagnostic testing is inappropriate, potentially dangerous, and outside the scope of my capabilities. This type of decision requires a licensed medical professional.

My role is to provide information, support understanding, and assist with general health-related topics within established guidelines.

If your symptoms persist without resolution, please seek immediate medical attention or contact a healthcare provider as soon as possible.
